panels.general_description: Twelve-lead electrocardiogram printed as twelve stacked rows on faint gridded paper.
panels.detailed_description: Twelve rows of electrocardiogram tracing, one per lead, stacked vertically on faint pink gridded paper; small printed lead labels at the left of each row read I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1, V2, V3, V4, V5 and V6, each preceded by a rectangular calibration pulse. Each row spans the full width and shows a regular repeating pattern of narrow upright or inverted spikes at similar spacing across the strip. In the V1 and V2 rows the portion that follows each spike is raised and dome-shaped, while the V3 to V6 rows show a flatter portion after each spike. No patient name, date, time, device text or scale text is printed on the image.
